log(λi)=β0+β1(IMD ranki)+Si

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

lad_model <- lad_data %>%
  left_join(final, by = c("LAD24CD" = "area_code"))

lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  rename(
    stillbirths = stillbirths.x,
    births = births.x,
    IMD_rank = IMD_rank.x
  )

# Scale predictors
lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  mutate(
    IMD_rank_scaled = as.numeric(scale(IMD_rank))
  )

# England model data
england_sf <- lad_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(IMD_rank_scaled),
    !is.na(stillbirths),
    !is.na(births),
    births > 0,
    str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")
  )

england_sf <- england_sf[card(poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)) > 0, ]

england_data <- england_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

england_nb <- poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)

england_W <- listw2mat(nb2listw(england_nb, style = "B"))
england_W <- (england_W + t(england_W)) / 2
england_W <- ifelse(england_W > 0, 1, 0)

england_model_imd <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = stillbirths ~ IMD_rank_scaled +
    offset(log(births)),
  family = "poisson",
  data = england_data,
  W = england_W,
  burnin = 10000,
  n.sample = 50000
)

# Regression coefficients
england_results <- england_model_imd$summary.results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = rownames(.),
    model = "England (IMD model)"
  )

beta_results <- england_results

# Spatial correlation parameter
spatial_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England (IMD model)",
  spatial_correlation = england_model_imd$summary.results["rho", "Mean"]
)

# Unexplained spatial variance
variance_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England (IMD model)",
  unexplained_variance = var(as.vector(england_model_imd$samples$phi))
)

# Combine results
CARBayes_results <- list(
  regression_coefficients = beta_results,
  spatial_correlation = spatial_results,
  unexplained_variance = variance_results
)

write_xlsx(
  CARBayes_results,
  file.path(folder, "CARBayes_IMD_model_results.xlsx")
)

# Predicted stillbirth counts
england_data$predicted_stillbirths <- england_model_imd$fitted.values

# Observed vs predicted plot
observed_predicted_plot <- ggplot(
  england_data,
  aes(x = predicted_stillbirths, y = stillbirths)
) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    colour = "red",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs Predicted Stillbirth Counts (IMD Spatial Model)",
    x = "Predicted stillbirths",
    y = "Observed stillbirths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  file.path(folder, "observed_vs_predicted_IMD_model.png"),
  observed_predicted_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

observed_predicted_plot
```

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(spdep)
library(writexl)

n <- nrow(england_sf)

observed <- england_data$stillbirths
predicted <- numeric(n)

for(i in 1:n){
train_sf <- england_sf[-i, ]
train_data <- england_data[-i, ]

nb_train <- poly2nb(train_sf, queen = TRUE)

keep <- card(nb_train) > 0

train_sf <- train_sf[keep, ]
train_data <- train_data[keep, ]

nb_train <- poly2nb(train_sf, queen = TRUE)

W_train <- listw2mat(nb2listw(nb_train, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE))
W_train <- (W_train + t(W_train)) / 2
W_train <- ifelse(W_train > 0, 1, 0)

  model <- S.CARleroux(
    formula =
      stillbirths ~
      IMD_rank_scaled +
      offset(log(births)),
    family = "poisson",
    data = train_data,
    W = W_train,
    burnin = 10000,
    n.sample = 50000
  )

  beta <- model$samples$beta

  beta_mean <- apply(beta, 2, mean)

  eta <-
    beta_mean[1] +
    beta_mean[2] * england_data$IMD_rank_scaled[i] +
    log(england_data$births[i])

  predicted[i] <- exp(eta)
}

rmse <- sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2))

bias <- mean(predicted - observed)

results <- data.frame(
  LAD = england_data$LAD24CD,
  observed = observed,
  predicted = predicted,
  error = predicted - observed
)

print(rmse)
print(bias)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    predictions = results,
    validation = data.frame(
      RMSE = rmse,
      Bias = bias
    )
  ),
  file.path(folder, "LOOCV_IMD_model.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Create folder for IMD model plots

plot_folder <- file.path(folder, "Deprivation Model Plots")

if(!dir.exists(plot_folder)){
  dir.create(plot_folder)
}

# Download full UK LAD shapefile

url <- paste0(
  "https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query",
  "?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=geojson"
)

lad_uk <- st_read(
  url,
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Prepare England model data

england_plot_data <- england_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    stillbirth_rate_per_1000 = (stillbirths / births) * 1000
  )


# Join England results onto UK shapefile

lad_data <- lad_uk %>%
  left_join(
    england_plot_data %>%
      select(
        LAD24CD,
        stillbirth_rate_per_1000,
        IMD_rank
      ),
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )


# Stillbirth rate map

stillbirth_plot <- ggplot(lad_data) +

  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = stillbirth_rate_per_1000),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Stillbirths\nper 1000 births"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Stillbirth Rate by Local Authority District"
  ) +

  theme_void()


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_folder,
    "stillbirth_rate_map.png"
  ),
  plot = stillbirth_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)



# IMD map

imd_plot <- ggplot(lad_data) +

  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = IMD_rank),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "IMD Rank"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Index of Multiple Deprivation by Local Authority District"
  ) +

  theme_void()


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_folder,
    "IMD_map.png"
  ),
  plot = imd_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)

# Hotspot threshold

threshold <- 3.9


# Posterior fitted values from IMD model

posterior_lambda <- england_model_imd$samples$fitted


# Convert posterior counts to rates per 1000 births

posterior_rate <- sweep(
  posterior_lambda,
  2,
  england_data$births,
  "/"
) * 1000


# Posterior probability of exceeding threshold

hotspot_probability <- colMeans(
  posterior_rate > threshold
)


# Add probabilities to England spatial data

england_sf$hotspot_probability <- hotspot_probability


# Load UK LAD map

uk_lad <- st_read(
  file.path(folder, "LAD_2024_UK_BGC.gpkg"),
  quiet = TRUE
)


# Join hotspot probabilities

uk_map <- uk_lad %>%
  left_join(
    england_sf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(
        LAD24CD,
        hotspot_probability
      ),
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )


# Plot hotspot probability map

hotspot_map <- ggplot() +

  # UK background
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_map,
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +

  # England posterior probabilities
  geom_sf(
    data = filter(
      uk_map,
      !is.na(hotspot_probability)
    ),
    aes(
      fill = hotspot_probability
    ),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Posterior\nprobability"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Posterior probability of exceeding 3.9 stillbirths per 1,000 births"
    ),
  ) +

  theme_void()


# Save plot

ggsave(
  file.path(
    plot_folder,
    "posterior_hotspot_probability_IMD_model.png"
  ),
  hotspot_map,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```
